title: The Rain, 2001
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Fourth January. The rain, the dog, the frame shop's rain alley. Silent again. On purpose now.

panels.composition: The rain alley behind the frame shop. The spackle buckets. Rain in sheets. WOOD in the doorway with BARNABY.

image.prompt: a narrow alley behind a shop in sheeting rain, two upturned spackle buckets, a young man and a small dog in the doorway, dense hatching, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Same, the dog has gone out into it.

image.prompt: the same alley, the small dog out in the rain, the young man still in the doorway, no words

panels.composition: Same, Wood on a bucket in the rain. The dog on the other.

characters.pose: on a bucket, in the rain

image.prompt: the same alley, the young man sitting on one spackle bucket in the rain and the dog sitting on the other, no words
the same alley, the same two figures on buckets in rain, held, black and white, no words
image.notes: The Rain fixture is silent from here on. Four identical framings; the change is who's in the rain.

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)
